Package cafe94.system.model.user

Class Customer

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.model.user.User
cafe94.system.model.user.Customer
public class Customer extends User
Represents a customer in the Cafe94 system. Each customer has a unique ID, personal details, address, and order history.
